name: timeline_super
description: Build a super timeline with Plaso: log2timeline over the whole image, then psort to JSON lines. Returns the storage file, the event count, the first and last event, and a sample. Slow by design; give it a narrow parser list when you know what you are after.

source.description: An image, a partition, a directory or a triage collection

out_dir.description: Where the storage file and the output land, under work/

parsers.description: Plaso parser filter, e.g. 'winreg,winevtx,prefetch' — far faster than the default

timezone.description: The evidence machine's timezone, e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul'. Output stays UTC.

sample.description: How many events to return inline (default 20)
